title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
summary: "Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech."
llm_summary: Despite the billions poured into AI and the buzz surrounding it, an Apollo Global Management economist finds that most U.S. companies—outside of the tech sector—haven’t seen any measurable financial gains from their AI spend. The data suggest that, so far, AI’s promised bottom‑line impact remains largely unrealized for the broader corporate landscape.
